## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical knowledge of building production-ready ML pipelines with strong data isolation, governance, and risk controls in real-time financial applications.

## Key Concepts

- **Operational Safety**: Blue/green deployments with automated rollback and cost budgets provide reliable model serving.
- **Compliance & Explainability**: PII masking, audit logging, and SHAP-based explainability ensure regulatory requirements are met while maintaining transparency in fraud predictions.

- Data Catalog: Free for metadata management
